UnlockUsers.description:
Locked convenience accounts cannot log on to WUYING Terminal and therefore cannot access any WUYING cloud resources. To allow a convenience account to log on to WUYING Terminal, you must first unlock it.  

> You can invoke [DescribeUsers](~~283609~~) to query convenience account information. If the value of `Status` in the returned data is 0, the convenience account is not locked. If the value of `Status` is 9, the convenience account is locked.
